title: Full App
description: Authenticated product — Supabase auth + Postgres + RLS, Tailwind UI, deployed with local Node execution and GitHub CI/delivery. The default for anything with user accounts and persisted data.
defaultStack: Next.js 16 (App Router) · Supabase (auth + Postgres + RLS) · Tailwind · local Node runtime · GitHub CI/delivery
whenToUse: Any product with logged-in users, roles, and a database. Pick this when users sign up, data persists per-user, and RLS must isolate tenants.
